items.title: Jason Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...we got a chance to hear Ronelle Johnson. He talked about his family... if we use you and the Marsalis family, and the Johnson family, as examples...

ctx.x: Yeah, the Jordans. But last night we went to the Palm Court, and we got a chance to hear Ronelle Johnson. He talked about his family. For me, there seems to be, in New Orleans, this tradition of nurturing musical culture within the family. We can see it from the dawn of jazz up to the present, if we use you and the Marsalis family, and the Johnson family, as examples, just a couple examples out of many.
Yeah. There’s also the Barbarin family.
